title: You accidentally liked someone's photo from 2022

lines.text: Code red! Code red! We just double-tapped Jordan's photo... from 2022!
Okay. Nobody panic. We just unlike it.
They still get the notification! Now they know we were down there. In the archives. At two A M!
Easy. We like every photo they've ever posted. Then it looks like a strategy.
That's not a strategy. That's a confession.
Plan B! Throw the phone in a lake!
The like is on the internet. Not the phone.
Then we throw the internet in a lake.
Delete the account! Change our name! Move to another country!
I've always wanted to be a Gerald.
Or... we put the phone down. And act normal.
Act... normal?
Never heard of it.
Incoming! Jordan replied!
Read it! No, don't read it! Okay, read it!
Ha ha, oh my god. I just accidentally liked your photo from 2019.
They were in the archives too! Now we're even!
Oh, thank goodness.
Now let's like one from 2015. Show them who's boss.
Don't touch that!
Code red!
